exact_holds.reason: Original pinout figures 13.3.8.1-1,13.3.8.2-1 and13.3.8.2-2 cannot be independently pixel-inspected; full contact geometry and all SMPM14 channels cannot be certified.
Original ANSI/VITA65.1 tables 6.4.5.6.3-1,6.4.5.6.4-1,6.5.4.6.4-1 not examined; C239 pointers are not native content audit.
Full original ANSI/VITA67.3 SMPM10/14 coax connector definitions unread, no independent mechanical intermateability assertion.
Full optical VITA66.5 native original unread; §13.3.8 names it but provides no exhaustive original optical-pin rules.
C239 DSDM, IDL and six OpenAPI native originals still unread; physical pin mapping is not an API schema.
Figure13.3.8.2-1 caption references ANSI/VITA 65.1 Table6.5.4.6.4-1, whereas Rule13.3.8.2-2 references 6.4.5.6.4-1; cannot adjudicate without native originals.
Numbered Rule13.3.8.2-2 appears without Rule13.3.8.2-1 in directly available inline text; do not invent missing text.
Rule13.3.8.1-1 has no Conformance Methodology label printed adjacent in directly reviewed C239 text; do not assign T by analogy.
Recommendation13.3.8.2-1 prints should with T, not a universal SHALL.
B1 and B4 channel mapping described only for one/two analog channels; remaining eight-channel diagram cannot be reconstructed from Observation.
Ten printed SMPM10 pin-label text entries read, but actual graphical contact orientation/geometry not verified.
§13.3.8.1 applies to 3U Radial Clock Profile, not all sensors or SOSA PIC types.
Edition1.1 notes further definition of all SOSA slot profiles as future; do not infer present universal requirements.
RF/IF analog signal path definitions are not observed sensor outputs, measured frequency, or live status without actual case evidence.
Physical standards Rule/Recommendation/Observation not automatically adopted as DIM class/cardinality or CSAPI Profile SHALL.
No Dragino/AirGradient/Campbell/Bennett source establishes installed SOSA PIC, SMPM coax, chassis I/O or independent hardware conformance.
Earlier 19/17/16/17 exact packet-local holds remain, including unverified dense AMPS table matrices.
SOSA Edition2.0 2025 Snapshot3 native source not assessed in this packet; Edition1.1 C239 findings not upgraded.
§13.4 VNX PIC source excluded and cannot be advanced without another owner's Proceed.
